lede: Florida Atlantic carries the stronger underlying team rating — -4.8 against -5.4, a 0.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.

Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
